title: Olo Pay — data notes
audience: Dashboard Builder Chat. Digital payments channel. Not in-shop Genius/Xenial POS. Not Worldpay settlement.

source.system: Olo Pay (Stripe processor on Olo billing transactions)
joins: GOLD_SEMANTIC.SALES.VW_DIM_STORE_CURATED on NEWCOID = store code AND OWNERSHIP = 'Company Owned'. Inner join — Franchised and unmapped shops are excluded.
source.shop_list: GOLD_SEMANTIC.SALES.VW_DIM_STORE_CURATED.OWNERSHIP = Company Owned. Same filter as Genius/Gold. No Excel mapping file.

files.weekly_data: olo_pay_data_YYYYMMDD.json — YYYYMMDD is the Monday week start. One week per file.
files.methodology: olo_pay_methodology.json — rewrite only when definitions change (--write-methodology).

columns.name: SALES_VOLUME
columns.definition: Sum of COALESCE(FINAL_AMOUNT, INITIAL_AMOUNT) for Stripe TYPE=Sale AND STATUS=Approved on Company Owned shops only.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COUNT
columns.definition: Count of those approved Sale rows (after BILLING_TRANSACTION_ID dedupe).

columns.name: ORDER_COUNT
columns.definition: Distinct ORDER_ID on approved Sale rows.

columns.name: auth_rate_pct
columns.definition: Approved Sale ÷ (Approved + Declined + Failure) Sale attempts × 100.

columns.name: card_brand_mix
columns.definition: ACCOUNT_ISSUER on approved Sales: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Not Apple Pay / Google Pay.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.definition: BILLING_TRANSACTION_ID on the source table (not written as a line dump in this JSON).

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.definition: Olo VENDOR_ID. Shop code is VENDOR_EXT_STORE_NUM when the vendor dim matches.

kpi_definitions.SALES_VOLUME: Approved Stripe Sale dollars at Company Owned shops. Tips sit in TIP_PORTION on the source row and are not subtracted here; amount is the billing total Olo stored.
kpi_definitions.AUTHORIZATION_RATE: Approved vs Declined or Failure on Sale attempts at Company Owned shops.
kpi_definitions.CARD_BRAND_MIX: Base card network from ACCOUNT_ISSUER on Company Owned approved Sales. Wallet service is Phase 2.

data_quality: Week buckets from local transacted date, Monday–Sunday, same cadence as Genius.
Null amounts excluded from dollar sums.
Inquiry and RegisterMerchant types excluded (not a capture).
On this feed, approved Sale TRANSACTION_COUNT equals distinct ORDER_ID (one capture per order).
Company Owned only. Franchised and unmapped shops are excluded from sales, counts, auth rate, and brand mix.
not_in_this_extract: Apple Pay / Google Pay identifiers (BILLING_SCHEME_NM) — Phase 2
Line-level JSON dump of every transaction
